headline: Steroids grew the jaw
body: but not the way anyone says

headline: The study
body: Wistar-Kyoto rats, juvenile and adult, **70 days** of nandrolone against control. | Lateral head films before and after, digitised at 300% for measurement precision. | Two dimensions measured: mandibular *length* and mandibular *height*.
punch: Two age groups. Two dimensions. Four results.

headline: In juveniles
body: *Height* rose **41.2%** in treated animals against **32.0%** in controls. | That difference was statistically significant at P<.05. | *Length* rose 27.2% against 24.5%.
punch: _But for length, no statistical group difference existed._

headline: In adults
body: it flipped. | *Length* rose **4.7%** in treated against **0.3%** in controls. Significant at **P<.001**. | *Height* rose 2.0% against 1.4%, and that difference was not significant.
punch: ==Each age group had one significant dimension. Different ones.==

headline: Which is the real finding
body: Not that steroids grow the jaw in general. | Juveniles gained *height*. Adults gained *length*. | The same compound moved a different dimension depending on when it was given.

headline: The adult result
body: is the striking one. | Adult controls gained **0.2 mm** of mandibular length over 70 days. Essentially nothing. | Adult treated animals gained **3.6 mm**.
punch: Adult craniofacial bone is not finished responding.

headline: And the mechanism
body: tracks it. | In juveniles, IGF-1 levels were comparable between treated and control. | In adults, treated animals ran **10% higher** IGF-1, significant at P<.01.
punch: ==The hormone difference appears only where the length difference does.==

headline: Which matters
body: because facial harmony depends on the *ratio* between dimensions, not the size of one. | A compound that moves height in one age group and length in another is not scaling a jaw. | It is changing its shape.
punch: _Uneven change across dimensions is distortion, not enhancement._

headline: The limits
body: Female Wistar-Kyoto rats on supraphysiologic nandrolone. | Rodent craniofacial growth is not human craniofacial growth. | And two of the four measured comparisons showed no significant difference at all.
punch: Real, measured, and much narrower than it gets quoted as.
